item.fixercity.fixer_longsword.lore: A standard workshop blade. A Grade 9 Fixer's bread and butter.
item.fixercity.fixer_longsword.ability: Right-click: Dash Slash - dash 5 blocks, cutting everything in the path
item.fixercity.fixer_mace.lore: The most reliable argument in the Backstreets.
item.fixercity.fixer_mace.ability: Right-click: Ground Slam - damage and slow nearby foes; stronger while falling
item.fixercity.fixer_dagger.lore: Anyone who shows you their back is already finished.
item.fixercity.fixer_dagger.ability: Passive: 1.75x damage from behind / Right-click: Backstep
item.fixercity.fixer_revolver.lore: Bullets are expensive in the City. Every shot costs Ahn.
key_page.fixercity.rat.lore: A key page that rolls around the bottom of the Backstreets. Cheap to get, cheap to lose.
key_page.fixercity.office_fixer.lore: The body of an ordinary fixer from a small office. Nothing special, but dependable.
key_page.fixercity.zwei.lore: An Association that takes on protection work. Its job is to stand in front and hold.
key_page.fixercity.shi.lore: An Association for jobs that end in one stroke. Long fights do not favor it.
key_page.fixercity.liu.lore: An Association of fiery martial artists. Burns are nothing new.
key_page.fixercity.seven.lore: An Association that deals in information. It reads the enemy and points out the weak spot.
key_page.fixercity.thumb.lore: A soldier of a gun-wielding Syndicate. Not a single bullet is wasted.
key_page.fixercity.kurokumo.lore: A blade-wielding clan. The wounds it leaves do not close easily.
passive.fixercity.scramble.desc: Speed II while at or below 30% health
passive.fixercity.guard.desc: Grants Resistance I to other players within 5 blocks
passive.fixercity.first_strike.desc: If you have not attacked for 5s, the next hit deals 2x damage and 2x stagger
passive.fixercity.blaze.desc: Attacks ignite the target for 3s; fire damage taken is halved
passive.fixercity.analysis.desc: Hit targets become Exposed (+20% damage taken) and Glowing for 5s
passive.fixercity.marksman.desc: +30% revolver damage; 30% chance not to use a bullet
passive.fixercity.bleed.desc: Slash hits add 1 stack of Bleed (max 5)
tooltip.fixercity.page_use: Right-click to equip · Lost on death
